title: Worth the day trip!!
text:
This was a lovely tour! So much history and beauty to be inspired from. The monastery in Monserrat is stunning with many tucked away chapels throughout the mountain. Take the cable car up/down - it’s worth it.

Sitges is a beautiful coastal quaint town. Again filled with history dating back to 1800’s. If you can, try a restaurant that is in one of the narrow streets - it’s more local and less touristy. And don’t skip getting gelato and horchata at La Jijonenca del carrer major!!

author: tkb201674

title: Informative and very safe.
text: Jordin, our guide was informing and professional.  Our group of 8 felt like we were watched over regarding safety at all times. I chose not to go on the one hour hike to the chapel and cross because it was a little steep in places. I would highly recommend this tour.
author: Damian_M

title: The tour guide, Jordi,...
text:
The tour guide, Jordi, was awesome!  Best tour guide we’ve ever had. 

The tour was great but the hiking climb at Montserrat is not as easy as indicated. There are some steep inclines that older folks will find challenging.
author: Rick_G

title: Excellent tour with David
text:
This was an excellent full-day tour with our guide, David. He was incredibly knowledgeable about every area we visited, and his enthusiasm was contagious. His English was perfect, and his cheerful personality made the whole experience even better.

We learned so much about Montserrat, the monastery, and Sitges. We were lucky to witness a celebration at the monastery, which made the visit even more special. David guided us up the mountain to breathtaking views and shared fascinating insights along the way. In Sitges, he knew all the right spots to take us, and we thoroughly enjoyed each stop.
author: Deborah_L

title: Very good tour and tour...
text:
Very good tour and tour guide (Alan)
for both places, scenic roads, recommendations for free time, etc.
author: Anonymous

title: Amazing tour
text: James really looked after us well. His passion for his country and knowledge made this trip. You would be lucky to have him as your guide! The mountains were incredible and Sitges was glorious. All well timed and would recommend!
author: Nat_C

title: Great Experience
text: This day trip was amazing and perfect to experience a little bit of Barcelona outside of the city. The basilica of Monserrat was stunning and learning about its history was insightful. Next stop, Sitges was a quaint seaside town with lots of history. James or Javme (in Catalan) our tour guide was fantastic. All in all, a wonderful and well worth it experience. Thank you!
author: Lisabeth_A

title: Beautiful your out of the city of Barcelona
text: We had a great day tour with Jordi. He is very knowledgeable and funny. So close to Barcelona and yet so different, you won’t regret taking this day trip. I wouldn’t call the hike necessarily easy. I’d give it a 6/10 on the hard scale. I expected a 3😝 given the “easy” description.  Montserrat and Sitges are so different. I was so pleased to see both mountain and sea in the same day as an escape from the bustling city of Barcelona.
author: rennes94

title: Superb sights highlighted by exceptional tour guide Mountain monastery to beach front locale fare and smooth travel
text: We had a fabulous day with Alan touring Monserrat and Sitges. Pick up was right on time, good location, and timing avoided big,  big crowds. Alan shared valuable insights about history, landscape, nature, etc.  he made the tour special. And the sights were breathtaking. Best tour!
author: Georgia_O

title: AMAZING trip!
text: Our tour guide was incredible and chatted with us the entire time! He was very educated on the area and told us anything we could have wanted to know. It was so much fun and we absolutely loved Sitges and the warm weather! It was a lovely trip and I’d do it again in a heartbeat!
author: Lauren_T
